def add_text(slide, text, x, y, w, h, size=18, color=TEXT, bold=False, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font=FONT, valign=MSO_ANCHOR.TOP):
    box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(x), Inches(y), Inches(w), Inches(h))
    tf = box.text_frame
    tf.clear(); tf.margin_left=Inches(0.02); tf.margin_right=Inches(0.02); tf.margin_top=Inches(0.02); tf.margin_bottom=Inches(0.02)
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.vertical_anchor = valign
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = align
    run = p.add_run(); run.text = text
    run.font.name = font; run.font.size = Pt(size); run.font.bold = bold; run.font.color.rgb = color
    return box

def rounded_rect(slide, x, y, w, h, fill=WHITE, line=GRID, radius=True):
    shp = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE if radius else MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, Inches(x), Inches(y), Inches(w), Inches(h))
    shp.fill.solid(); shp.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill
    shp.line.color.rgb = line
    shp.line.width = Pt(0.8)
    return shp

def add_lab_legend(slide, x, y, labs=('OpenAI','Google','Anthropic','Muse Spark')):
    offset=0
    for lab in labs:
        slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.OVAL, Inches(x+offset), Inches(y+0.03), Inches(0.12), Inches(0.12)).fill.solid()
        dot = slide.shapes[-1]; dot.fill.fore_color.rgb = LAB_COLORS[lab]; dot.line.fill.background()
        add_text(slide, lab, x+offset+0.16, y, 0.85 if lab!='Muse Spark' else 1.0, 0.2, size=7.8, color=MUTED)
        offset += 1.05 if lab != 'Muse Spark' else 1.25

def infer_lab(model):
    m = model.lower()
    if 'gpt' in m or 'o3' in m or 'realtime' in m: return 'OpenAI'
    if 'gemini' in m: return 'Google'
    if 'claude' in m or 'opus' in m or 'sonnet' in m: return 'Anthropic'
    if 'muse' in m: return 'Muse Spark'
    return 'Unknown / not specified'

def add_badge(slide, text, x, y, color, w=1.3):
    shp=slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, Inches(x), Inches(y), Inches(w), Inches(0.32))
    shp.fill.solid(); shp.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    shp.line.fill.background()
    add_text(slide, text, x+0.05, y+0.075, w-0.1, 0.14, size=8, color=WHITE, bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    return shp

def add_bar(slide, x, y, w, h, value, maxv, color, label=None, score=None, ci=None, bg=RGBColor(235,240,246)):
    rounded_rect(slide, x, y, w, h, fill=bg, line=bg, radius=True)
    bw = max(0.02, w * value / maxv)
    rounded_rect(slide, x, y, bw, h, fill=color, line=color, radius=True)
    if label:
        add_text(slide, label, x, y-0.23, w*0.65, 0.18, size=7.4, color=TEXT, bold=True)
    if score is not None:
        s = f'{score:.2f}' + (f' ±{ci:.2f}' if ci is not None else '')
        add_text(slide, s, x+w+0.07, y-0.005, 0.75, h, size=7.3, color=TEXT, bold=True, valign=MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE)

def add_table(slide, x, y, col_ws, row_h, data, header_fill=NAVY, header_color=WHITE, font_size=8.0, fills=None):
    rows=len(data); cols=len(data[0])
    table = slide.shapes.add_table(rows, cols, Inches(x), Inches(y), Inches(sum(col_ws)), Inches(row_h*rows)).table
    for j,w in enumerate(col_ws): table.columns[j].width = Inches(w)
    for i in range(rows): table.rows[i].height = Inches(row_h)
    for i,row in enumerate(data):
        for j,val in enumerate(row):
            cell=table.cell(i,j)
            cell.text = str(val)
            cell.margin_left=Inches(0.04); cell.margin_right=Inches(0.04); cell.margin_top=Inches(0.02); cell.margin_bottom=Inches(0.02)
            p=cell.text_frame.paragraphs[0]
            p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER if j>0 else PP_ALIGN.LEFT
            r=p.runs[0]
            r.font.name=FONT; r.font.size=Pt(font_size if i>0 else font_size+0.2); r.font.bold = i==0
            if i==0:
                cell.fill.solid(); cell.fill.fore_color.rgb=header_fill; r.font.color.rgb=header_color
            else:
                cell.fill.solid(); cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = fills[i][j] if fills and fills[i][j] else (WHITE if i%2 else RGBColor(248,250,252))
                r.font.color.rgb=TEXT
            cell.line.color.rgb=GRID
    return table
